parameters.query: select id as document_id, 'system' as actor from documents where status = 'pending_erp' and erp_attempts < 3 and (booking_started_at is null or booking_started_at < now() - interval '2 minutes') order by created_at limit 50

update documents set booking_started_at = now() where id = $1::uuid and status = 'pending_erp' and (booking_started_at is null or booking_started_at < now() - interval '2 minutes') returning id, supplier_vat_id, supplier_name, invoice_number, doc_type::text as doc_type, invoice_date::text as invoice_date, due_date::text as due_date, currency, net_amount, vat_amount, gross_amount, po_number, $2::text as actor

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ external_ref: $json.id, supplier_vat_id: $json.supplier_vat_id, supplier_name: $json.supplier_name, invoice_number: $json.invoice_number, doc_type: $json.doc_type, invoice_date: $json.invoice_date, due_date: $json.due_date, currency: $json.currency, net_amount: Number($json.net_amount), vat_amount: Number($json.vat_amount), gross_amount: Number($json.gross_amount), po_number: $json.po_number, booked_by: $json.actor }) }}

parameters.query: with r as (select $1::uuid as id, $2::text as outcome, $3::text as erp_id, $4::text as msg, $5::text as actor), u as (update documents d set status = (case r.outcome when 'booked' then 'booked' when 'duplicate' then 'duplicate' when 'rejected' then 'needs_review' when 'error' then case when d.erp_attempts + 1 >= 3 then 'needs_review' else 'pending_erp' end else 'pending_erp' end)::doc_status, erp_invoice_id = case when r.outcome = 'booked' then r.erp_id::uuid else d.erp_invoice_id end, erp_attempts = d.erp_attempts + case when r.outcome = 'error' then 1 else 0 end, last_error = case when r.outcome = 'booked' then null else r.msg end, booking_started_at = null, updated_at = now(), reasons = case when r.outcome = 'duplicate' then d.reasons || '["ERP already has this supplier + invoice number."]'::jsonb when r.outcome = 'rejected' then d.reasons || jsonb_build_array('ERP refused the booking: ' || r.msg) when r.outcome = 'error' and d.erp_attempts + 1 >= 3 then d.reasons || jsonb_build_array('ERP booking failed 3 times: ' || r.msg || '. Check the values, then approve again.') else d.reasons end from r where d.id = r.id returning d.id, d.status), a as (insert into audit_log (actor, action, document_id, after, note) select r.actor, case r.outcome when 'booked' then 'erp_booked' when 'duplicate' then 'erp_rejected_duplicate' when 'rejected' then 'erp_rejected' when 'down' then 'erp_unavailable' else 'erp_error' end, r.id, jsonb_build_object('status', (select status from u), 'erp_invoice_id', r.erp_id), r.msg from r where r.outcome <> 'down' or not exists (select 1 from audit_log where document_id = r.id and action = 'erp_unavailable' and ts > now() - interval '1 hour') returning 1), s as (update erp_status set available = (r.outcome <> 'down'), note = case when r.outcome = 'down' then 'ERP not reachable at last booking attempt' else 'ERP answering' end, updated_at = now() from r where erp_status.id = 1 returning 1) select u.id as document_id, u.status::text as status, r.outcome, r.msg, (u.status = 'needs_review' and r.outcome in ('error', 'rejected')) as handed_back from u, r

with ex as (update alerts set occurrences = occurrences + 1, last_seen = now() where id = (select id from alerts where source = 'erp-booking' and message = $2 and not acknowledged and ts > now() - interval '24 hours' order by ts desc limit 1) returning id), ins as (insert into alerts (severity, source, message, details) select $1, 'erp-booking', $2, jsonb_build_object('document_id', $3, 'detail', $4)::jsonb where not exists (select 1 from ex) returning id) select (select id from ins) is not null as is_new, $1 as severity, 'erp-booking' as source, $2 as message

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $json.outcome === 'down' ? 'warning' : 'critical', $json.outcome === 'down' ? 'ERP not reachable; bookings wait and are retried every 5 minutes' : 'ERP booking returned to review: ' + ($json.outcome === 'rejected' ? 'ERP refused it' : 'failed 3 times'), $json.document_id, $json.msg ] }}

parameters.query: update alerts set acknowledged = true where source = 'erp-booking' and severity = 'warning' and not acknowledged returning id

parameters.subject: =[Hallmann intake · {{ $json.severity }}] {{ $json.message }}
